commentary: Market breadth is severely damaged with a score of 26 and the deterministic gate locked at WEAK. Four consecutive distribution days across benchmark indices, coupled with heavy FII liquidations ahead of the RBI MPC decision, demand strict defensive posture. As William O'Neil emphasized, three out of four stocks mirror the general market direction; in a declining tape, even sound breakouts frequently abort. Stan Weinstein's stage discipline warns that Stage 2 candidates operating under broad market distribution face immense overhead supply. Until an accumulation day or follow-through confirms market health, aggressive exposure is unwarranted. Traders must practice Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules, demanding verified earnings acceleration and executing rapid stop-loss discipline.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above its EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, hovering within 1.5% of the 20-session pivot. Double swing lows show neckline compression on 2x average volume, yet relative strength remains weak without institutional sponsorship.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe top-line contraction (-56.3% YoY) and net profit declining 25.6% YoY undermine the setup. Poor 3-year average ROE near 3.1% and fragile interest coverage fail CANSLIM quality filters. Lacks fundamental support.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Setup fails on a breakdown below the 97.24 pivot; cut losses immediately given deteriorating earnings fundamentals.

ADFFOODS.technical: Price trades constructively above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, clearing its 20-session high on a 2.74x volume expansion. RSI at 56 indicates steady momentum without extension, signaling Stage 2 continuation.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Sales grew +20.5% YoY supported by packaged food export demand. ROCE of 24.6% and negligible debt ensure stability, but sub-10% EPS expansion falls well short of CANSLIM's 25% threshold.
ADFFOODS.risk: Thesis invalidates below the 309.63 support; execute strict Minervini stop discipline to guard capital against distribution.

AEGISLOG.technical: Stock exhibits textbook Stage 2 power-trend characteristics, logging three higher highs and higher lows off its 21-EMA and 50-DMA. Up-thrust volume expansion and RSI at 58 confirm institutional sponsorship and high relative strength.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Superb CANSLIM profile with explosive EPS acceleration (+268% YoY) and 37.1% revenue growth driven by port terminal capacity. Robust operating margins near 30% and steady institutional ownership confirm market leadership.
AEGISLOG.risk: Setup fails below the 1383.26 swing low; respect stop discipline immediately if general market weakness triggers institutional distribution.

ALICON.technical: Price cleared its 20-session high backed by an exceptional 10.48x volume surge, signaling institutional accumulation. The moving average alignment (EMA21 > SMA50 > SMA200) satisfies Minervini's Trend Template, supported by bullish MACD momentum.
ALICON.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 37.9% YoY to ₹578 Cr while net profit gained 67.1% YoY. Robust order book visibility of ₹8,450 Cr provides runway, though ROCE of 11.2% warrants ongoing margin tracking.
ALICON.risk: Breakout thesis fails on a drop below 790.64; adhere strictly to stop-loss rules to prevent adverse drawdowns.

ARROWGREEN.technical: A double-bottom base is resolving as price challenges neckline resistance above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 moving averages. RSI at 64 exhibits healthy momentum and relative strength without reaching overbought levels.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM metrics with accelerating EPS (+40.7% YoY) and 19.9% sales growth. Operating margins exceed 35%, ROCE stands at an impressive 27.6%, and the balance sheet remains virtually debt-free.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Pattern is negated below the 849.35 base trough; exit promptly to protect capital against overhead supply shocks.

ATLANTAELE.technical: A double-bottom reversal structure formed an engulfing candle on 3.2x volume. Price remains neatly aligned above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 in a Stage 2 framework, but overhead distribution poses near-term resistance.
ATLANTAELE.fundamental: Strong business traction in power transformers drove 48% YoY sales expansion with stellar 45.3% ROCE and minimal debt. However, quarterly EPS YoY growth decelerated from triple digits to 58.6%, capping the read.
ATLANTAELE.risk: Base fails on a close below 1804.62; enforce Minervini-style risk controls to avert a potential Stage 3 rollover.
